usage: Case-insensitive token/phrase matching. Add retrieval terms; preserve original query. Do not replace substrings (e.g., PI inside another word), assign penalties, or turn expansions into established play facts. Rule IDs are retrieval hints, not verified answer citations. Use kicking team and receiving team for all special-teams plays. Ambiguous terms may expand to several topics and require clarification. No penalties or rulings should be inferred from slang alone.
